_note: THE SLOW JOURNEY, authored as STATIONS rather than a track (Ryan 2026-08-20: 'a painting is not something you race through... it's about the journey'). Each station names a place in MASTER px and two framings: WIDE (stand back and see the scene) and DETAIL (what the push goes in to look at). build-route.py turns these into camera keys using pacing laws -- never faster than the cap, zoom and dolly rate-limited -- so the FILM'S LENGTH EMERGES from the painting instead of being squeezed into a soundtrack. Every detail target is a real feature from the zone points files. Silent: Ryan's narration is the soundtrack.

stations.name: river-entry
stations.why: the ox party and travelers at the river crossing; living water, relief on the entry rocks

stations.name: ge-at-the-bridge
stations.why: Ge Hong crossing with fan raised, deer beside him, the family below -- the painting's subject

stations.name: upper-stream
stations.why: the pine over the bridge and the stream coming down from the gorge; gust cycle plays here

stations.name: gorge-walls
stations.why: the gorge closing in -- both walls turning, the waterfall behind

stations.name: cliff-nose
stations.why: the great cliff nose under the autumn trees -- the deepest push in the film

stations.name: fenced-path
stations.why: the railed path and gully footbridge -- the family's route up, a traveler on it

stations.name: compound-approach
stations.why: the path arriving at the fence and the autumn trees around it

stations.name: the-halls
stations.why: the lower hall with a figure standing in the doorway; thatch and open courtyard

stations.name: main-hall
stations.why: the main hall on its terrace -- the destination of the move to Mount Luofu

stations.name: rear-pines
stations.why: the dense pine grove behind the compound, the last inhabited place

stations.name: mist-release
stations.why: the release: the camera RISES into the mist and far peaks and pulls BACK (negative dolly, reverse parallax) instead of pushing in -- the journey ends by opening out. Its own safe rect climbs through the gap LEFT of the inscription (x<4200), so peaks are reachable without cropping calligraphy into the frame.
